findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (66 ayes, 47 noes)
findings.note: Roll call lists Goodwin among the ayes. HB 958 (sixth edition) lets a voter without photo ID cast a provisional ballot and bring ID to the county board by noon on the fifth business day after the election; extends the same window where driver license or Social Security digits do not match; keeps a photocopy of ID or an affidavit in the absentee envelope rules; treats certain Class C licenses as valid photo ID for voting; and requires registration applicants to affirm US citizenship, with a statement under penalty of perjury if the question is left blank.

findings.note: Roll call lists Goodwin among the ayes on the final concurrence vote. The bill was ratified and the Governor vetoed it on 2026-08-17 (bill page https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958).

findings.motion: House roll call 758, HB 958 Election Law Changes, second reading, passed 66-47
findings.note: Official House roll call transcript lists him among the Ayes. The version voted on (fifth edition) keeps photo ID for in-person voting and provisional ballots counted only if photo ID is shown to the county board, lengthens the time to show it to five business days, sets a similar ID fix for voters whose driver license or Social Security digits do not match, and treats a missing ID photocopy with an absentee ballot as a curable defect.
